tools.name: get_risk_return_metrics
tools.description: Gale Finance's published return, CAGR, volatility, Sharpe, Sortino and max drawdown for one asset (stock, ETF, crypto, or commodity), on its 1Y window and its long window (5Y or since inception), each with a one-line method note and the canonical Gale page to cite. Example: "What's the Sortino ratio

tools.name: get_downside_risk
tools.description: Gale Finance's published downside risk for one asset: daily 5% VaR, expected shortfall, skew and excess kurtosis, the largest drawdown episodes with peak/trough/recovery dates, 1Y max drawdown, and best/worst day from a published compare page. Example: "What are the tail risks for bitcoin?".

tools.name: compare_assets
tools.description: Compare two assets using Gale Finance's published pair pages: the rolling 1Y compare (default), a calendar-year compare (horizon "2024"), or the long-term scorecard with year-by-year returns (horizon "long_term"). Pairs resolve in either order and keep the cited page's A/B labels. When Gale has no p

tools.name: rank_assets_by_metric
tools.description: Rank the assets Gale Finance covers by one published metric (return, cagr, volatility, sharpe, sortino, max_drawdown, var_5, es_5, skew, excess_kurtosis), optionally filtered by asset type. Each row carries its value, window dates, and Gale page. Example: "Which crypto had the best Sharpe last year?

tools.name: find_assets
tools.description: Search the assets Gale Finance covers by ticker or name and list, for each, its asset page and the published pair comparisons, calendar-year pages, and long-term scorecards. Omit query to page through all coverage. Example: "Do you cover Hyperliquid?".
